name: Wiki Special Anti Acne Serum 30ml | Clears Acne & Soothes Skin
description:
Say goodbye to stubborn breakouts with Wiki Special Anti Acne Serum – your daily defense against pimples, blemishes, and clogged pores. This lightweight, fast-absorbing serum penetrates deeply to purify pores, reduce inflammation, and restore clear skin. Perfect for oily and acne-prone skin, it also helps fade acne marks and balances skin tone for a smoother, radiant complexion. Dermatologist tested and gentle on skin, it’s ideal for consistent daily use.
Key Features
 Fights acne, pimples, and blemishes at the root
 Lightweight, non-greasy, and fast-absorbing formula
 Reduces redness, irritation, and swelling
 Helps fade acne marks and dark spots
 Suitable for daily AM & PM use
 Dermatologist tested & skin-friendly
How to Use
 Cleanse your face with a gentle face wash
 Apply 2–3 drops of serum on affected areas
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use daily in the morning and evening for best results
Material
Active anti-acne agents, soothing botanicals, hydrating extracts
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes
 1 × Wiki Special Anti Acne Serum (30ml)
